race_start.description: Marks the beginning of the race

event_meta.message: Race begins with 22 drivers competing over 28 laps

race_finish.description: Marks the completion of the race

position_gain.description: Driver gains a single position through overtaking
position_gain.commentary_suggestions: Emphasize the overtaking move, position gained, use exciting language

position_loss.commentary_suggestions: Note the position loss, suggest potential struggle or pressure

multi_position_gain.description: Driver gains multiple positions in a single sector, indicating strong performance or incident ahead
multi_position_gain.commentary_suggestions: Use dramatic language, emphasize significant progress through field

multi_position_loss.description: Driver loses multiple positions in a single sector, potentially indicating incident or major issue
multi_position_loss.commentary_suggestions: Suggest concern, potential trouble, dramatic tone

leader_change.description: A new driver takes the lead of the race
leader_change.commentary_suggestions: High energy, emphasize leadership change, dramatic moment

podium_position_change.description: A driver moves into or changes position within the podium spots (P1-P3)

fastest_sector.description: Driver records a sector time in the fastest performance bracket (top 2%)
fastest_sector.commentary_suggestions: Praise exceptional sector performance, use superlatives

anomalous_slow_sector.description: Driver records a sector significantly slower than their average (15%+ slower)
anomalous_slow_sector.commentary_suggestions: Express concern, suggest potential issues, traffic, or off-track excursion

personal_best_sector.description: Driver sets their personal best time for a specific sector (only reported after lap 3)
personal_best_sector.commentary_suggestions: Positive tone, note improvement and rhythm
personal_best_sector.detection_rules: Only reported from lap 3 onwards to reduce early-race noise

personal_best_lap.description: Driver completes their fastest lap of the race (only reported after lap 3)
personal_best_lap.commentary_suggestions: Celebrate the achievement, note consistency or improvement
personal_best_lap.detection_rules: Only reported from lap 3 onwards to reduce early-race noise

race_best_sector.description: Driver sets the fastest sector time of any driver in the race so far
race_best_sector.commentary_suggestions: High energy, emphasize race-wide significance, exceptional performance

close_battle.description: Driver is in a sustained battle with the car ahead (within 1 second for 3+ sectors)

metadata_fields.car_ahead_number: Car number of car being pursued
metadata_fields.average_gap_seconds: Average gap over the battle duration
metadata_fields.battle_duration_sectors: Number of sectors this battle has persisted

close_battle.commentary_suggestions: Build tension, suggest imminent overtake possibility, exciting tone. Battle has been sustained so emphasize the intensity.
close_battle.detection_rules: Only reported after battle persists for 3+ sectors, with 2-lap cooldown between reports of same battle

large_gap_to_leader.description: Driver is running significantly behind the race leader (15+ seconds)
large_gap_to_leader.commentary_suggestions: Factual tone, provide context on race situation

laps_down.description: Driver goes a lap down to the race leader
laps_down.commentary_suggestions: Neutral tone, note difficult situation for driver

strong_race_pace.description: Driver shows consistent forward progress, gaining 3+ positions from early to late race
strong_race_pace.commentary_suggestions: Praise consistency and race craft, highlight strong drive

falling_back.description: Driver loses 3+ positions from early to late race, indicating pace or reliability issues
falling_back.commentary_suggestions: Sympathetic tone, suggest potential issues affecting performance
